messages:
sarah-support: FYI we just got an enterprise escalation from Acme — intermittent 5xx + client timeouts hitting hosted inference since ~10:02 UTC. They see ~15% error rate for a specific endpoint. creating war room :rotating_light:
liam-sre: joining. any PagerDuty alerts?
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20260317-8421 — Priority P1. Notifying oncall.
sarah-support: pd shows increased 502/504 from gateway for route /v1/infer/acme-prod. customer included trace-id 7f9a3c2b. They reported it spikes when sending longer-context prompts.
devon-runtime: looked at ingress metrics — gateway latency spikes then upstream 504s. signs of KV cache miss storms and some backend goroutine timeouts. correlating with latest batcher config pushed 2h ago.
elaine-eng: I rolled out batcher tweak at 08:00 UTC to reduce batching delay (target 20ms). Could be exposing a pathologial seq-length distribution. rolling back to previous value now.
deploy-bot: Rollback started for change batcher/target_delay -> 50ms by elaine-eng. CI -> canary -> prod.
liam-sre: while rollback runs, mitigation suggestions: 1) temporary route level circuit-breaker to 20rps for that tenant 2) pin them to a smaller model variant 3) enable upstream fallback to dedicated pool. Which is quickest?
sarah-support: customer needs low friction. pinning to smaller model variant might be fastest — can we do that per-tenant?
devon-runtime: yes, we can route by api-key -> model-variant in the gateway. I can flip routing rule in ~5m. Doing a quick curl test first to repro locally.
customer-success: customer on call, they've captured a sample payload that reproduces timeouts. sent to #secure-attachments.
liam-sre: repro attempt: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer X-ACME" -d @sample.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer/acme-prod  -> 504 after 10s. trace-id matches 7f9a3c2b. attaching logs: "upstream timeout after 9.8s"
devon-runtime: looking at model-server logs for that trace: kvcache MISS storm, high seq-len (6k tokens), excessive memory pressure led to GC pauses then request timeouts. Also seeing a flurry of 429->retries from batching layer.
elaine-eng: rollback completed to previous batcher config. Canary healthy. Rolling through remaining hosts.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed in 4m. Canary -> 25% -> 100% across prod. No errors reported from canary.
liam-sre: after rollback, error rate dropped from 15% -> 2% in 3m. customer still sees occasional timeouts but much improved. recommend action items: 1) schedule follow-up postmortem 2) add automated vec of seq-length guard in gateway 3) update runbook for per-tenant model pinning 4) add alert on kvcache miss rate spike.
sarah-support: noted. I've opened support ticket SUP-9821 to keep customer updated and track credits. Assigned to customer-success.
customer-success: pinged Acme, they accepted temporary model pin and are testing. asked for ETA on full fix.
devon-runtime: immediate short-term fix applied: routing rule pinned Acme API key to model-sm-2. Verified success with sample: response 200 in 420ms.
elaine-eng: long-term: we should add adaptive batching/backpressure for extreme seq lengths, improve kv-cache prefetching for common prefixes, and add a regression test that simulates long-context bursts. I'll own the RFC.
liam-sre: action items and owners: - RCA doc + postmortem: liam-sre - Runbook update (tenant pinning + circuit break): devops-runbook@eng, owner devon-runtime - KV cache miss alert: elaine-eng - Adaptive batching RFC: elaine-eng - Customer follow-up + credits: sarah-support/customer-success
sarah-support: scheduling postmortem meeting Weds 16:00 UTC, invite sent to eng/sre/support/CS.
oncall-bot: Acknowledged. Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z.
liam-sre: quick note for postmortem timeline: 08:00 UTC batcher change -> 10:02 customer reports -> 10:05 PD + warroom -> 10:07 rollback started -> 10:11 rollback complete -> 10:14 error rate back down. will add graphs to doc.
sarah-support: thanks. closing warroom thread here, moving to postmortem thread for action tracking. :thumbsup:
